notes: A start and finish read from the map (chk-maps run 74). Ten levels, dest1..dest12, each level's floor an anti-standing trap run as sinking blocks. The finish is the one teleport to `dest13`, the music-button room, inside the trigger that says 'Map by Dotty!' and plays the end sound. The five func_doors are touch-opening trapdoors in the drop shaft between levels 7 and 8; the importer runs no outputs, so they are opened. Not published.

conditional_teleports.note: The anti-standing trap: touching a block renames the player `activator` after 0.09 s and back to `default` after 0.1 s; the teleports behind filter_activator fire only on that name. Run as sinking blocks.
